results.content:
Metabase is a good choice if you want plug‑and‑play embedded dashboards instead of wiring charts yourself — it’s recommended when analytics isn’t your core product.

  Key options to consider:

  + Build yourself: teams often start with Highcharts (or similar JS libraries) for interactivity, but this can quickly grow in complexity.
  + Use an embedded BI SDK: embedding a product like Metabase speeds delivery and handles common needs (filters, pivots, exports).
  + Use an AI‑first platform: Basedash can connect many sources and auto‑generate charts/insights to reduce engineering work.

  If you need bespoke interactions, expect more engineering time; otherwise embed a BI tool.
